name: Lü Xiao'ai
source:
Coay is a little girl found outside enja Defence Science Institute and she always tags along Anatoliy. Her temper is notoriously bad. Though she doesn't like to listen to others' opinions, she is not entirely unreasonable.

She lives with her mother. Nobody knows where her father went.

She can't resist the temptation of any delicious food.
